races.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
races.verdict: MACANUDO has a far more solid profile than most of these and a reproduction of recent efforts looks sure to see him go well. Little Jaybee is another with recent winning form to her name so she's a threat, as too is Ten Cuidado if in the same form as 10 days ago. MACANUDO (IRE) LITTLE JAYBEE TEN CUIDADO (IRE)

races.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: NOLTON CROSS is fancied to make a big impact returning to a C&D where he's won twice before and with a handy mark to work with, he can prove too strong for John T , who ran well when second here 26 days ago and is building a good all-weather profile. Oneforthegutter is well treated and will be staying on strongly if they go hard enough for him. NOLTON CROSS (IRE) JOHN T ONEFORTHEGUTTER

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap
races.verdict: BENACRE is well handicapped on last winter's form and could prove a different proposition with visor applied and freshened up by a break. He therefore looks worth chancing. Lillie Margot has a solid-looking profile and shouldn't be far away, while Orangesandlemons won over C&D in the past and may do better down in grade. BENACRE (IRE) LILLIE MARGOT ORANGESANDLEMONS

races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: FENAROLI shaped with plenty of promise when third behind a couple boasting prior experience at Kempton 4 weeks ago, coming from much further back than that pair in the process. Very well bred and looking sure to improve, this looks a good opening for Harry Charlton's colt. Bombora is very much a work in progress but Karl Burke's colt may well still emerge as the chief threat. FENAROLI BOMBORA KNIGHTBOLT (IRE)

races.title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: RIBENSKA 's best efforts have come on all-weather and with this return to 7f sure to be in her favour, Charlie Fellowes' 4-y-o gets the tentative nod to double her tally from a sliding mark at the expense of Enola Grey , who looked unlucky not to finish closer at Wolverhampton recently. Course winner Spirit of Jenny rounds off the shortlist. RIBENSKA (IRE) ENOLA GREY (IRE) SPIRIT OF JENNY (IRE)

races.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Nursery
races.verdict: An open-looking sprint in which it could pay to side with NORTH STAR KODI , who boasts some strong maiden form at Hamilton back in the spring and the handicapper has given him a chance having failed to fire in a couple of nurseries thus far. Pride's Queen took a step forward switched to a nursery last time, so she heads up the dangers, with Commander Keith and Angelic Melody taken to fight out third. NORTH STAR KODI (IRE) PRIDE'S QUEEN COMMANDER KEITH (IRE)

races.title: Make The Move To Midnite Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CELESTIAL FIRE showed plenty to work on amidst greenness when third at Redcar back in the spring and with improvement likely now stepped up in trip, Archie Watson's filly earns the vote over Hoya Bella , who is bred for longer trips but has shaped promisingly in both starts to date. Classic Bellini can edge out Wadima for minor honours. CELESTIAL FIRE (IRE) HOYA BELLA CLASSIC BELLINI

races.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict: Harry Charlton 3-y-o THAT'S RANDOM might be worth siding with to resume his progression with his recent Leicester outing behind him. Modern Times was a bit better than the result when fifth at Kempton last month and is feared most back at the scene of his success in July. Fair Y Isle has a progressive profile on all-weather and could also play a part if fully primed after a break. THAT'S RANDOM MODERN TIMES FAIR Y ISLE

races.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: In a finale where the majority arrive with a point to prove the vote goes to PRINCE OF PILLO after his back-to-form second here last time. Infinity Blue 's infrequent visits to the track this year suggests there's been the odd issue but he shaped quite well on his reappearance at the end of the summer and is second choice ahead of Maldevious . PRINCE OF PILLO (IRE) INFINITY BLUE (IRE) MALDEVIOUS (IRE)
